residual: r_i=y_i-p_annual_i; positive means annual probability too low on that observed sample, negative too high. Never confuse residual with y minus annual training label frequency. Ensemble r uses the equal mean of three saved annual probabilities; never sigmoid of mean logits.

Report n, unique intervals, total edge uses, union edges, mean/max edge multiplicity, overlapping interval-pair count and maximum count of disjoint intervals via earliest-finish scheduling, for all5state scopes(all+4) x3views x23cutoffs. These are mechanical target-overlap measures, not effective independent sample size; even disjoint returns or Friday samples may be serially dependent. metrics: Original annual accuracy,Brier,logloss,AUROC,balancedaccuracy,probability spread, up-count/down-count and calibration residual for23cutoffs x5state scopes x3views x4learnedmethods x4seedroles. seed=-1 here denotes equal-probability ensemble, not a new random seed. Compare archived R37 state/shared/half against annual using allpair inversion and tie-change counts and within-cell AUROC, for4methods x4seedroles x23cutoffs x4states x3policies. Ensemble may reorder because averaging differently shifted seeds is not a common monotone map of the original mean; pooled years/states can reorder. All sparse/empty cells kept.
brier: Use only saved weekly probabilities: delta=p_corrected-p_annual, e=y-p_annual. Exact candidate-minus-annual Brier difference=delta^2-2*delta*e. First component nonnegative, second sign reflects alignment with subsequently observed residual. Save perweek, seed and ensemble for all3R37policies; summarize by period/method/seed over allweeks and R37eligible-only. This is algebraic loss accounting, not causal proof, a deployable rule or a new prediction.
